limits: The complete new directory gains 328 passes and retains two Date-dependent failures, eight resource stops and 47 unsupported modes. Every other new observation is identical.
Eight modes stop during array setup at the existing index limit. Thirty-nine hit unimplemented array indexed/length descriptors; metadata excludes two Proxy and six resizable-buffer modes.
Both older String.lastIndexOf failures pass. All 9466 other older observations and 2448 controls are identical. All policies and fingerprints are unchanged.
The new inventory remains an observation report: resource stops still cause failure and prevent healthy baseline recording. Existing 25 healthy gates remain.
Logical lengths do not allocate a collection. Per-index and prototype work/storage, string equality and author callbacks consume existing shared budgets; no quota was raised.
Host object property support, array storage/descriptors, Date, BigInt, Proxy, resizable buffers and broader language/web compatibility remain incomplete.
No independent review, security audit, GPU exercise or Chromium performance comparison was performed.
